snippet.title: River Drift Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
River Drift is a chaotic, physics-based co-op rafting challenge set in a deadly swamp where everything can damage your raft. Team up with a friend to paddle forwards or backwards allowing for quick turns. Choose your path through dangerous branching river routes filled with crocodiles, hippos, traps and unexpected hazards. Gather wood to repair your raft and survive the unpredictable current, as teamwork becomes your only way forward.

Wishlsit on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4382680/River_Drift/?beta=1
